text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as all of Mejiro Ardan's training
for the day had finished—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Would it be alright
if I ran for just a little bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, a classmate of mine mentioned having a strange
experience on the track after sundown, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Apparently footsteps were coming up behind them while running, but when they whipped around, nobody was there..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"They say 'fear often creates delusions,'
but I'd still like to investigate the true nature
of the footsteps our classmate heard."
choice_data_list: I can't permit it, as you'd be overworking yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So I am permitted to continue running.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall report to you tomorrow
whether or not I encountered any ghosts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Mejiro Ardan
continued to run the track well into the night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. Overworking carries the risk of injury, so I'll hold off on running."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Instead, while you do your cool-down stretches and icing, I'll search to see if there are any ghosts around.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, they never found any ghosts, but at least excessive overtraining was avoided.
